# SMAA lookup textures

From https://github.com/iryoku/smaa at commit 71c806a838bdd7d517df19192a20f0c61b3ca29d (MIT license, `LICENSE.txt`), unchanged:
`AreaTex.h` and `SearchTex.h`, included by `src/EnvMapVulkan/EnvMapVulkanAntialiasing.cpp`.

The shader code, `SMAA.hlsl` of the same commit, is `Resources/Shaders/Include/SMAA.glslh`, also unchanged: shaders are compiled at run time from `Resources/`.
